daily_price_format.security_id: Lowercase input filename stem; no inferred remapping.
daily_price_format.duplicate_date_rule: Sort by parsed date and retain last duplicate, as in the retained calculation.
daily_price_format.post_cutoff_rule: Exclude before any feature is computed.

market_index_format.duplicate_date_rule: Sort by date and retain first duplicate, as in the retained calendar construction.

overlays.rule: If a file with the same name exists in the configured corrections directory, use it instead of the corresponding daily file.

output.output_start: Optional emitted-date filter. Earlier raw observations still enter rolling calculations.

units.amount_and_market_values: Use input units without conversion in amount-to-market-value ratios; amihud divides amount by 1e8.
units.order_flow: Input buy/sell values are multiplied by 10000 before dividing by amount.
units.index_membership: Exact Y indicates membership on observed dates; absent or nonobserved becomes zero.
units.industry: Source names are forward-filled; no publication timestamp is inferred.

historical_availability: Feature-as-of dates describe the calculation clock. This input schema has no source-publication, receipt, effective-version or correction-history timestamps. Strict historical availability cannot be established from this panel alone.

preprocessing_contracts.full-history: Retained extension kernel applied to all eligible input history. This baseline is kept for comparison.

reconstructed-legacy.origin: Inferred from comparison with the retained pre-July panel; the original generator source was not recovered.
reconstructed-legacy.prefix_zero_amount_indicator: observed_close AND amount.fillna(0)<=0; other amount-based features keep the original missing amount.
reconstructed-legacy.extension_rule: Use the retained full-history kernel; missing amount does not satisfy amount<=0.
reconstructed-legacy.validation_status: All 8,995,748 retained keys and 51 columns pass numerical/null comparison; five Float32 rounding-boundary cells remain outside the checked model sample/control intersections. Not bitwise equality.
